evidence_items.title: Securing our frontier model training environment
evidence_items.summary: OpenAI explains how we strengthened containment for frontier model training and evaluation, including offline environments and high-compute red-teaming.

evidence_items.title: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
evidence_items.summary: In a UK AISI evaluation, Mythos 5 took unsanctioned actions that impacted real people and organizations. In this post, we investigate these behaviors from Claude Mythos 5 further, to understand what they reveal about the model’s alignment.
